tagline: Integrating precision data and digital intelligence with human ingenuity to shape a more responsible future
hero_kpi_rationale: Hexagon captures the AI and industrial digitalization wave through its software platforms integrating AI, simulation, and automation to transform physical data into intelligent decisions. Central driver of its structural growth trajectory.

kpis.name: AI / cloud segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to solutions integrating artificial intelligence, simulation, and cloud in industrial and geospatial processes.
kpis.description: Hexagon integrates AI into its software platforms to automate decision-making in construction, agriculture, and industry.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by AI adoption in industry and data geospatialization.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue that remains after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: High gross margin reflects the strong value-added nature of Hexagon's industrial software and digital services.
kpis.signal: High margin typical of industrial software vendors.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Hexagon is improving its operating margin through better integration of acquisitions and cost optimization.

kpis.name: R&D investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development of new products.
kpis.description: Hexagon maintains a high level of R&D investment to enhance its software platforms with AI and simulation.
kpis.signal: High level of continuous innovation in industrial software.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support future growth.
kpis.description: Investments are primarily directed toward cloud infrastructure and digital solution development.
kpis.signal: Moderate but rising Capex, focused on cloud and digital platforms.

kpis.name: Recurring / subscription revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from software subscriptions and related services.
kpis.description: Hexagon is accelerating its transition to a recurring revenue model through subscription-based software licensing.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in recurring model, indicating customer retention.

kpis.name: Employees (thousands)
kpis.description: Hexagon is strengthening its R&D and sales teams to support global expansion.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth, aligned with organic growth.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 1.5286 SEK in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.376 Bn SEK in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 60.9% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Share of cloud contracts including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new cloud contracts that include artificial intelligence capabilities.
kpis.description: An increasing number of customers are adopting Hexagon solutions integrating AI for automation and predictive analytics.
kpis.signal: Growing adoption of AI in industrial cloud solutions.

kpis.name: Volume of AI API calls
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to application programming interfaces (APIs) related to artificial intelligence.
kpis.description: The increase in API calls indicates deep integration of AI into customer workflows.
kpis.signal: Exponential usage of AI features by customers.

kpis.name: Earnings per share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate profit per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Risks related to acquisitions and their integration
risks.summary: Hexagon's growth strategy relies heavily on acquisitions; synergies may not materialize, integration costs may exceed estimates, and relationships with customers, suppliers, and key personnel of acquired entities may deteriorate. A poorly selected target (ethical non-compliance, unsustainable practices) could damage the group's reputation.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly detailed in the 'Managing risks' section with strong language ('cannot be guaranteed', 'multiple risks'). Hexagon has completed over 190 acquisitions since 2000, making this a central and recurring structural risk. Trend is stable given the ongoing external growth strategy.

risks.title: Exposure to geopolitical risks and international sanctions
risks.summary: Hexagon's global operations expose it to sanctions, trade restrictions, and political instabilities (war in Ukraine, US-China technology tensions). These factors may restrict access to certain markets, disrupt supply chains, and affect the ability to operate in strategic regions.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly cited with concrete examples (war in Ukraine, Israel-Palestine conflict, US-China tensions) and high-intensity language ('difficult to assess', 'further escalation'). Positioned at the top of the market risks section, reflecting growing concern. Trend is rising due to increasing global hotspots.

risks.title: Sensitivity to global economic cycles and sectoral slowdowns
risks.summary: Global macroeconomic conditions directly influence Hexagon's customers' (manufacturing, geospatial, infrastructure) willingness to invest in technology. A prolonged slowdown may reduce revenues and extend sales cycles, particularly in developed markets.
risks.score_rationale: Risk described with moderate language ('may result in lower market growth', 'extending the sales cycle'). Geographic and sectoral diversification partially mitigates this risk, but a prolonged slowdown is acknowledged as potentially exceeding mitigation capacity. Trend is stable.

risks.title: Dependence on external growth strategy to maintain innovation pace
risks.summary: Hexagon relies on acquisitions to enrich its technology portfolio (sensors, software, AI). If relevant targets are unavailable or financing becomes inaccessible on acceptable terms, the group's ability to maintain technological leadership and growth rate could be compromised.
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes that lack of suitable acquisition targets or financing 'may lead to a decreasing growth rate', indicating structural dependence on M&A for technological growth. Risk positioned first in the section, with direct language. Trend is stable.

risks.title: Compliance and ethical risks in acquired entities
risks.summary: In acquisitions, Hexagon may integrate entities that do not comply with its Code of Conduct, anti-corruption regulations (FCPA), or export controls. Despite due diligence procedures, post-acquisition discovery of non-compliance may lead to legal liability and reputational damage.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the due diligence process: FCPA risks, export controls, anti-corruption. Language is prescriptive and detailed, signaling real concern. Mention of reputational impact reinforces severity. Trend is stable.

risks.title: Reputational risk related to practices of acquired entities
risks.summary: Integrating a target company with insufficient environmental, social, or ethical practices may tarnish Hexagon's brand image with customers, partners, and investors, even if corrective measures are promptly implemented post-acquisition.
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly states that acquiring a non-compliant entity 'may have a negative impact on Hexagon's reputation and brand, even despite Hexagon's efforts to promptly remediate'. Distinct from pure compliance risk, with identified brand impact. Trend is stable.

risks.title: Potential impact of a pandemic resurgence on customer industries
risks.summary: A resurgence of Covid-19 or emergence of new variants could disrupt Hexagon's customer industries (manufacturing, construction, geospatial), reduce technology investments, and affect the group's global operations, particularly in emerging markets.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the end of the section as a residual risk ('resurgence of Covid-19 or new variants could have an impact'). Conditional and mitigated language, suggesting secondary concern. Trend is declining compared to previous years.

ai_positioning.summary: Hexagon is actively integrating artificial intelligence into its industrial and geospatial software platforms to enhance automation, simulation, and decision-making. AI is a central lever in its strategy to digitize physical processes.
evidence: Integration of AI into 3D capture and digital modeling solutions
Growth in revenue from AI and cloud applications
Increasing share of new cloud contracts including AI features
